drivers: Simple Latin-square distribution: each row/column contains the same three cell types (3 striped, 1 empty, 4 solid), so the missing cell is the one type absent from row 3
Attributes (count, fill) are bound together in a fixed package, reducing working-memory load
Distractors with pentagons and mixed count/fill combos are easy to reject once the pattern is seen, but 3-solid and 4-striped hexagons can catch careless responders
Generous 75-second limit for a single-rule item
